messages:
Samira Q: Quick routing question  we're converting contractor Leo M to a 0.55 FTE perm IC3. Proposed FTE comp $142,000 -> prorated $78,100. At 55% the S4 prorated cap is $76,000, so we're ~2.1k over. Preferred start 2026-08-03, fallback 2026-08-17 depending on payroll. What's the approval path?

Devon H: Candidate accepted verbally. No relocation. Manager justification ready. Candidate prefers base bump over equity.

Priya - People Ops: Routing checklist: manager justification + org head signoff; finance to confirm prorate and funding; comp committee for any >$2k prorate variance (this looks borderline); legal for contractor->employee conversion paperwork; benefits for part-time eligibility and effective date; payroll for cutoff. Paste justification and org code and I'll open ticket.

Samira Q: Manager justification: "Leo has deep knowledge of our inference runtime and will lead the quantization migration. Conversion avoids repeated ramping costs and preserves delivery cadence." Org code ENG-RT.

Finance Ops: Confirming prorate math. Need chargeback center. If committee requests uplift, include annualized budget delta. At ~2.1k prorate variance this typically goes to comp committee, may not need VP unless annualized >$4k.

Priya - People Ops: Opening HR ticket HR-3061234567. Routing: finance@, comp-committee@, legal@, benefits@. Please respond in-thread with `+approve` or `-need info`. Payroll cutoff for 2026-08-03 start is 2026-07-20; if we miss it, earliest payroll start will be 2026-09-01.

Comp Chair: We'll review on Mon. Please attach benchmarking doc. Options: approve a small band exception, shift to higher band with justification, or approve a one-time cash top-up instead of base. Since candidate prefers base, committee will consider base uplift if justified.

Devon H: Attaching benchmarking in the ticket now. Candidate confirmed base preference in writing.

Payroll Bot: Noted payroll cutoff 2026-07-20 for retroactive start. Also confirm last contractor invoice date to avoid overlap.

Samira Q: Last contractor invoice planned 2026-07-31, no planned overlap. Candidate can accept 2026-08-17 if needed.

Comp Chair: +approve to put on agenda (not final). If committee approves the ~2.1k variance we'll log an exception. If denied, we'll propose a $2k one-time sign-on instead of base to hit comp guidelines.

Priya - People Ops: Thanks all  I'll post committee outcome here after Mon meeting. Devon please confirm chargeback org code and payroll preference (retro vs next window).

Devon H: Org code ENG-RT-02, prefer retro if possible. Candidate confirmed in writing and signed offer will be ready pending comp outcome.

Priya - People Ops: Great :thumbsup: HR-3061234567 updated. Will loop VP People only if comp committee requests escalation.
